first_public_note: CVPR 2021 proceedings (CVF open access, June 2021); no arXiv preprint found by title search; DOI 10.1109/CVPR46437.2021.01312 (Crossref, pages 13320-13328; the cvpr21-ren manifest DOI .01295 belongs to another paper). Both wiki folders hold the same PDF (sha256 8e978d62...). Window: prior before 2020-12, [concurrent] 2020-12 to 2021-12, [later] after 2021-12.
population: One filtered population for all topics (tools/pop.py): index rows with a camera modality whose title or ledger names lip reading, VSR, LRW, LRS2/3 or speechreading and whose ledger names a model (network, HMM, classifier, decoder, CTC, seq2seq, attention, distillation, WER ...); titles naming surveys, datasets, perception, enhancement or separation, synthesis or video-to-speech, talking heads, forgery, synchronisation, keyword spotting or challenges removed; versions grouped by ledger key; target removed; off-task rows removed on reading (tools/exclude.txt). 582 groups: prior 221, [concurrent] 21, date unresolved 20, [later] 320.

inherited.M01: Voiced broadcast and TED speech video with paired audio (LRW, LRS2, LRS3)
inherited.M04: Video only at test; audio feeds the master and audio tutor in training only
inherited.M05: 25 fps RGB lip crops 112x112 after dlib landmark alignment (Afouras et al. 2018 preprocessing); raw waveform for the master
inherited.M06: 3D conv + ResNet-18 front-end; temporal convolution (word) or TM-seq2seq (sentence), Afouras et al. 2018 / Stafylakis lineage
inherited.M07: External LM use not stated; compared rows mix LM and no-LM
inherited.M11: Benchmark splits (LRW, LRS2-BBC, LRS3-TED); speaker overlap not stated
inherited.M13: Training hours only (Table 6); no inference cost

topics.inclusion_rule: Published rule kept. For this review: the 221 prior and 21 [concurrent] lip-reading / VSR / AVSR decoders of the shared population, classified by full-text pattern (mentions included, snippets of every prior and concurrent hit read) for distillation, an audio or ASR teacher, an audio-visual teacher, and a teacher that is trained jointly with or updated from the student. Boundary: mentions in related work and reference lists are not designs; acoustic-only students are out; versions once.
topics.metric: LRW top-1 accuracy (higher) and LRS2 WER (lower), same student with and without the teacher

topics.inclusion_rule: Lip-reading / VSR / AVSR decoders of the shared population that order or stage training samples by a curriculum; design compared: order by utterance length (words or short sentences first) against order by sample difficulty or a model's confidence. Boundary: noise or SNR curricula of enhancement systems, mentions of curricula not used, and the word 'curriculum' in other senses are excluded on reading; versions once.
topics.pattern: ledger text names curriculum and lip reading / VSR / LRW / LRS; dated counts over the shared population by full-text pattern
topics.metric: WER with and without the curriculum, same model

topics.inclusion_rule: Published rule kept. For this review: decoders of the shared population that report visual-only results on LRS2 before 2020-12, counted for run-to-run spread (seeds, repeated runs, standard deviation, intervals) and for language-model mention (pattern match, mention counts).
topics.metric: LRS2 visual-only WER, lower better; LM and training hours stated
